title: Private Bay of Fundy Tour: Walk the Ocean Floor at Burntcoat Head
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the incredible power of the Bay of Fundy on a carefully timed coastal adventure designed around the famous changing tides. 
This tour takes you to Burntcoat Head Park, where you can walk on the ocean floor at low tide, explore scenic coastal viewpoints, and discover the science behind the world's highest tides. With stops at Dawson Dowell Park, the Fundy Tidal Interpretive Centre, and an optional local food or coffee break, you'll enjoy a perfect blend of nature, education, and authentic Nova Scotia experiences. Tide schedules are carefully considered to provide the best possible experience.
